title: Haul-Away Crew Charge on Moved Large-Item Deliveries, Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
Where a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders** carries haul-away and the customer reschedules the appointment, a **late-change crew charge** applies, taking the haul-away charge still standing on the order, that is the haul-away charged less refunds of it.

| Haul-away still standing (above zero) | Request falls on | Crew charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the scheduled day | that standing haul-away amount |
| yes | an earlier day | the program's haul-away fee for one item, 25.00 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery |
| no | any day | none |

**Hypothetical cases.** An order with 50.00 of haul-away charged and 20.00 refunded against it has 30.00 standing: a request on the scheduled day carries a crew charge of 30.00 and a request three days ahead carries 25.00. An order whose haul-away has been refunded in full, or that carries none, has no crew charge.
